area: presentation tuning DATA: a juice.json mutation sweep, and a cap that was not data-owned

find.report_claim: cycles 170/171 used mutation sweeps to find gameplay constants the suite did not protect; the README calls the suite the canonical regression shield and juice.json the tuning file a designer edits
find.live_evidence: a 12-case sweep doubled juice.json constants and ran the full suite for each: nine stayed green (slam_ring.width, slam_ring.height, spawn_mark.width, spawn_mark.height, spawn_mark.max, pad_pulse.amplitude, impact_burst, kill_burst, flash_life_s); three were caught (pad_pulse.base, hitstop_ticks, tracer_life_s)
find.consumer_evidence: probing the most surprising survivor showed spawn_mark.max is not even wired: with max=2 the spawn path kept 2 marks but boss_summon kept 4; with max=6 the list held 6 marks while only 4 marker nodes existed, so the player still saw 4. build_scene sized _spawn_nodes from the module constant MAX_SPAWN_MARKS and both _play_event branches truncated to it

read: tests/test_spawn_mark.py, tests/test_slam_ring.py, tests/test_pad_pulse.py (presence checks, no value bands)
killed: pinning the raw literals from juice.json: that restates the data and would drift exactly like the stale keystone pins in cycle 138
raising MAX_SPAWN_MARKS to a new constant: the summon path would still ignore the DATA key, so the tunable would remain a lie
letting the list grow past the node pool: extra spawn marks would be invisible and the cap would look honoured in state but not on screen
analyze.survivor: one DATA read (_spawn_mark_cap) for the node pool and both event paths, plus observable design-band tests for every surviving constant

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py gains ShooterGame._spawn_mark_cap() (max(1, int(juice.spawn_mark.max)), MAX_SPAWN_MARKS only when absent) and uses it for the marker node pool, the spawn-event truncation and both boss_summon truncations; tests/test_spawn_mark.py gains two tests proving the value sizes the pool and bounds both paths; tests/test_juice_tuning.py (7 tests) pins the surviving constants by observable result inside design bands; README.md lists the new test

shooter.before: probe max=2: pool nodes=4, spawn marks=2, summon marks=4; probe max=6: pool nodes=4, spawn marks=6, visible=4, summon marks=4
shooter.after: probe max=2: pool nodes=2, spawn marks=2, visible=2, summon marks=2; probe max=6: pool nodes=6, spawn marks=6, visible=6, summon marks=6; removing the key falls back to MAX_SPAWN_MARKS=4
shooter.mutations: all nine sweep survivors now fail a targeted test when doubled (9/9 caught, survivors: none); reverting the three wiring reads to MAX_SPAWN_MARKS fails test_the_data_cap_sizes_the_pool_and_bounds_the_spawn_path and test_the_summon_path_uses_the_same_data_cap with the old 4-vs-2 values, and game.py was restored byte-identically (sha256 8671e1a226bb44ca67a11875909313481c782c5f0c727735c8cb70d130c21691)
shooter.codebase_map: regenerated after adding the _spawn_mark_cap symbol; guidelines gate green

recorded_not_fixed.fallback_drift: four sim.py fallback defaults disagree with the shipped juice.json values: tracer_life_s 0.08 vs 0.15, flash_life_s 0.06 vs 0.10, pickup_fx_scale 3.0 vs 1.5, pickup_fx_rise 1.2 vs 0.9. A missing key silently changes feel; separate from the wired-value problem fixed here, left for a dedicated defaults-vs-data cycle
